piv_reset_unsupported:
PIV reset not supported: this key does not support PIV forced reset.

The PIV applet on this key cannot be reset via software. PIV reset is a Yubico vendor extension, not all keys support it. PIV keys and certificates still exist but cannot be cleared by keyroost.

Other applets (FIDO, OATH, OpenPGP) are not affected and can be reset normally.
piv_reset_incomplete:
PIV reset incomplete: {}

PIN and PUK have been blocked, but the card rejected the reset command.
The PIV applet was not wiped, keys and certificates still exist.
Cannot complete this operation via keyroost.

Other applets (FIDO, OATH, OpenPGP) are not affected.
piv_puk_guess_accepted:
PIV PUK guess successful: PUK is correct, PIN has been reset.

This means the PUK was not blocked, reset cannot continue.
Please use the correct PUK to block the PIN first, then try resetting again.
